description: This file defines classes, data structures, and functions for parsing and serializing HTTP structured headers according to RFC8941 and Draft 9 standards. It includes implementations for various header data types such as items, lists, dictionaries, and their associated parsing functions.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents a structured header item which can be an integer, decimal, string, token, byte sequence, or boolean.

classes.name: ParameterisedIdentifier
classes.description: Represents a parameterized identifier with an item and associated parameters.

classes.name: ParameterizedItem
classes.description: Represents an item with optional parameters.

classes.name: ParameterizedMember
classes.description: Represents a member which can be an item or an inner list, with parameters.

classes.name: Dictionary
classes.description: Represents a structured header dictionary with key-value pairs.
